description: Authoritative Formatting, Overloading, and Linting Rule Matrix for Citation Studio

citationStandards.name: APA 7 (Author, Year)
citationStandards.inBodyRule: Parenthetical author-date enclosed in parentheses with comma separator
citationStandards.bottomRule: APA 7 un-prefixed bibliographic entry with hanging indent and italicized journal/volume
citationStandards.exampleBottom: Chen, Q., Spapé, M. M., & Jacucci, G. (2024). Understanding Phantom Tactile Sensation on Commercially Available Social Virtual Reality Platforms. *ACM TOCHI*, *31*(4), 1-34.

citationStandards.name: APA 7 Narrative Author (Year)
citationStandards.inBodyRule: Author surname in prose followed by year in parentheses
citationStandards.exampleBottom: Chen, Q., Spapé, M. M., & Jacucci, G. (2024). Understanding Phantom Tactile Sensation on Commercially Available Social Virtual Reality Platforms. *ACM TOCHI*, *31*(4), 1-34.

citationStandards.name: IEEE [1]
citationStandards.bottomRule: IEEE bibliographic entry prefixed with square-bracketed sequential index [N]
citationStandards.exampleBottom: [1] Q. Chen, M. M. Spapé, and G. Jacucci, "Understanding Phantom Tactile Sensation on Commercially Available Social Virtual Reality Platforms," *ACM TOCHI*, vol. 31, no. 4, pp. 1-34, 2024.

citationStandards.name: Harvard (Author Year)
citationStandards.inBodyRule: Author and year in parentheses without comma separator
citationStandards.bottomRule: Harvard bibliographic entry with year in parentheses directly following authors
citationStandards.exampleBottom: Chen, Q., Spapé, M. M. and Jacucci, G. (2024) 'Understanding Phantom Tactile Sensation on Commercially Available Social Virtual Reality Platforms', *ACM TOCHI*, 31(4), pp. 1-34.

citationStandards.name: Chicago (Author Year)
citationStandards.inBodyRule: Author and year in parentheses without comma separator
citationStandards.bottomRule: Chicago Author-Date bibliographic entry with year directly following inverted author name
citationStandards.exampleBottom: Chen, Qi, Michiel M. Spapé, and Giulio Jacucci. 2024. "Understanding Phantom Tactile Sensation on Commercially Available Social Virtual Reality Platforms." *ACM TOCHI* 31 (4): 1-34.

citationStandards.name: Vancouver (1)
citationStandards.bottomRule: Vancouver bibliographic entry prefixed with number and period (N.)
citationStandards.exampleBottom: 1. Chen Qi, Spapé Michiel M, Jacucci Giulio. Understanding Phantom Tactile Sensation on Commercially Available Social Virtual Reality Platforms. ACM TOCHI. 2024;31(4):1-34.

citationStandards.name: Pandoc Citekey [@key]
citationStandards.inBodyRule: Pandoc citekey prefixed with @ inside square brackets
citationStandards.exampleBottom: Chen, Q., Spapé, M. M., & Jacucci, G. (2024). Understanding Phantom Tactile Sensation on Commercially Available Social Virtual Reality Platforms. *ACM TOCHI*, *31*(4), 1-34.

citationStandards.name: Global Footnote Mode [^key]
citationStandards.bottomRule: Footnote definition prefixed with [^citekey]: and formatted in bucket citation style
citationStandards.exampleBottom: [^Chen2024]: Chen, Q., Spapé, M. M., & Jacucci, G. (2024). Understanding Phantom Tactile Sensation on Commercially Available Social Virtual Reality Platforms. *ACM TOCHI*, *31*(4), 1-34.

overloadingRules.mergingRule: Merge into single bracket, separated by semicolons: [@Smith2020; @Jones2021]
Merge into single parenthetical, sorted alphabetically by first author surname with semicolon delimiter
Merge into single bracket comma-separated numeric list: [1, 2]
Merge into single parenthesis comma-separated numeric list: (1, 2)

overloadingRules.incomingAction: Insert new reference inside or adjacent to [^Smith2020]

linterDecisionMatrix.stateCondition: Footnote Mode ON, In-Body is (Author, Year)
Footnote Mode ON, In-Body is (AuthorA, Year; AuthorB, Year)
linterDecisionMatrix.message: Expected footnote citation in Footnote Mode.
linterDecisionMatrix.batchFixAction: Replace entire parenthetical group with contiguous footnotes

linterDecisionMatrix.stateCondition: Footnote Mode ON, Bottom definition missing [^citekey]: prefix
linterDecisionMatrix.message: Convert reference line to [^citekey]: footnote definition in Footnote Mode.
linterDecisionMatrix.batchFixAction: Prepend [^citekey]: and format definition according to bucket standard

linterDecisionMatrix.message: Expected {targetFormat} citation for [^citekey] (Footnote Mode is disabled).

linterDecisionMatrix.stateCondition: Footnote Mode OFF, Bottom definition has [^citekey]: stub
linterDecisionMatrix.message: Convert [^citekey]: stub to standard reference entry.
linterDecisionMatrix.batchFixAction: Strip [^citekey]: prefix and reformat as standard bibliography line

linterDecisionMatrix.stateCondition: Bottom reference entry present, but cited 0 times in-body (Both Modes)
linterDecisionMatrix.message: Reference definition is not cited anywhere in this file.
linterDecisionMatrix.batchFixAction: Remove orphan reference line from note

linterDecisionMatrix.stateCondition: In-body citekey or footnote not registered in any connected library
linterDecisionMatrix.message: Citekey is not registered in any connected reference library.
linterDecisionMatrix.batchFixAction: Open Create Entry modal or Purge reference from document
